name: Fascia Academy
author: Josh
description: A free course on fascia, elastic movement and the forgotten system behind every great athlete.
eyebrow: A free course · Pillar I: The Body
headline: The secret your gym never taught you.
subhead: Modern fitness trains muscles in isolation. The greatest athletes move as one connected, elastic system. Learn the history, the science of fascia, and simple at-home practices to move freely and stay resilient.

creators.name: The Secret of Athleticism
creators.about: Creator of Hyperarch Fascia Training and author of Secret of Athleticism. The primary source for this course's fascia theory and practice: the foot, elasticity, and how great athletes really move.

creators.name: Nick Ball Training
creators.about: Trainer and GOATA specialist focused on restoring natural, pain-free movement patterns: feet, ankles, hips and the connected way the greatest athletes move.
